title: Good Medicine Is Difficult to Make
description: Zakariya seems to be having some trouble...

mainQuestExcel.description: Zakariya seems to be having some trouble...

dialogs.text: Oh! Traveler! Come over here, I'd like to ask a favor of you.
What happened?
Do you remember Maruf, the doctor from Aaru Village? He sent you to get a prescription from me last time.
The poor guy brewed a medicine, tasted it, and ended up retching and vomiting for days.
He said that the original prescription didn't work, so he sought to improve it.
What in Teyvat did he do to find himself in this miserable state?
*sigh* He must've done more than just adjusting the brewing method and modifying the amount of ingredients used.
This is not the first time it's happened. Maruf just can't learn his lesson, can he?
Forget it. Perhaps he ran into some difficulties.
Traveler, could you get some raw ingredients for me? I'll brew a soup myself. Please bring it to Maruf.
Leave it to me.
Maruf adjusted the prescription that I gave him for treating headaches.
I still need three Henna Berries. Could you get them for me?
You mean he's done something like this before?
Yeah, I can't remember how many times. Luckily, he seldom handles poisonous ingredients. Otherwise...

Are you sure we're using Scarabs to make the medicine?
Relax, I won't throw an entire bug into the soup, but some parts are useful.
I'm counting on you, Traveler. Do bring me the ingredients.
You mean he's done something like this before?

flow.stepDescription: Give the Henna Berries to Zakariya

dialogs.text: Traveler, did you get the Henna Berries?
Got them right here.
Thank you very much, Traveler. I'll get the medicine ready right away.
Zakariya returns inside and starts preparing the medicine...
Okay, now bring it to Maruf. I hope he learns his lesson this time.

Hmm, I don't think there was anything wrong with that ingredient, and I'm sure my brewing method was correct. What happened...
T—Traveler, what brings you here?
Zakariya sent me here.
So you must've heard about the mess I've made. This is embarrassing...
Anyway, drink the medicine first.
O—Okay...
Maruf drinks the medicine...
Phew... I feel much better. Zakariya's indeed a great doctor.
Why did you modify the prescription?
Do you remember the medicine we brewed together last time? It didn't work very well.
I thought I might've boiled it the wrong way or missed a few ingredients.
So I... Um... made another bowl based on my experience.
I tried it first as a reasonable precaution, and I believe you know the rest.
I just sent someone to get some medicine for me from Dr. Zakariya, but you beat him to the punch.
Thank you, Traveler. I'm going to get some rest now. After that I'll have to start receiving patients again.
I've been absent for so long... Many villagers must be waiting.
*sigh* But I'm running out of herbs again...
